title: Optimal Play in Hex on Finite and Infinite Boards
summary: The game of Hex is one of the most celebrated connection games in combinatorics. Although it is known that the first player always has a winning strategy, very little is understood about the complexity of optimal play. Following Campbell's introduction of the parameters $λ(n)$ and $δ(n)$, measuring respectively the length of the shortest guaranteed winning path and the minimum number of stones required by the first player to force a win, we establish new structural properties of these quantities.
